privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How the Aparna website handles your privacy: no accounts, no forms, no tracking.
privacy.lead: Aparna Home Appliances Pvt. Ltd. owns this website, a showroom for our products. It does not ask for your personal details, and it does not track you.

sections.heading: What this website is
paras: This website is a brand showcase and product catalogue: Aparna Home Appliances Pvt. Ltd. uses it to show our products, their specifications and MRP, and our events.
list: There is no online shop and no checkout.
There are no user accounts or log-ins.
There are no contact forms, enquiry forms or newsletter sign-ups.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paras: None. This website does not ask for, collect, sell or share your name, phone number, email address or home address.

sections.heading: No tracking
paras: This website uses no analytics, no tracking cookies, no advertising pixels and no chat widgets. Its fonts, pictures and videos are served from the website itself, not from other companies’ servers.

sections.heading: What is stored on your device
paras: One small note, kept by your own browser: a flag so the opening animation plays only the first time you visit during a browsing session. It holds no personal information and is cleared when you close the tab or window.
The website sets no cookies and keeps no list of the products you look at.

sections.heading: Links to other websites and apps
paras: “Share on WhatsApp” opens WhatsApp with a link to the product. Our Facebook, Instagram, Threads and YouTube buttons open those platforms. Each of them is run by another company under its own privacy policy, which applies once you use it.

sections.heading: Hosting and server logs
paras: Like most websites, the company that hosts this website may keep standard technical records for a short time, such as your IP address, the time of your visit and your browser type. These are used only to keep the website secure and working reliably.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paras: If the way this website works changes, we will update this page and the date above.
